# Check if any user has "maya" or "chen" in their name or email
import json

# Parse the users list - strip ANSI codes and shell prompt
import re
clean = re.sub(r'\x1b\[[0-9;]*m', '', users_output)

lines = clean.split('\n')

for i, line in enumerate(lines):
